mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 42 degrees with a real-feel of 34 under clear skies at Verona Area High School, accompanied by a waxing crescent moon.

The City of Verona has announced that municipal candidate packets are available for the 2027 spring election, and the city is also moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to improve local accessibility.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness taking place today, ART House 360 Thursday nights also today, and Hop Haus Trivia scheduled for Thursday.
In police news, on October 25, officers responded to an intersection where they discovered a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an O W I arrest.
You can look forward to the delicious Devil's Food Cake as today's flavor, and the store will open today at 10:00 AM.
